seo_title: ISA Comparison: UK Savings Comparison Site | The Brandle
summary: Our own UK comparison site: Cash ISA rates ranked by rate alone, eight calculators and plain answers on the rules.
description: ISA Comparison, our own UK site that ranks Cash ISA rates by rate alone and explains the rules in plain English. Designed and built by The Brandle in Dubai.

brief.label: Personal finance, UK
brief.heading: The idea
paras: UK savers get a £20,000 tax-free ISA allowance, then get buried in rate tables sorted by who pays the most commission. We wanted one that is sorted by the rate, and nothing else.

answer.label: Built by us
answer.heading: What we built
paras: A fast comparison site that lists Cash ISA rates ranked by rate alone, with the date each one was last checked against the provider's own page. Links that can earn a commission are marked, and they never change the order.

Around it: eight calculators that turn rates into pounds, guides to every ISA type, and the Budget news written so a normal person can follow it. New posts go out on a schedule, so it never goes stale.
